title: Barriers after copies give TRANSFER_WRITE as the source access with shader stages or BOTTOM_OF_PIPE as the source stage
fix_note: no upstream fix (issue open); the fixed variant uses VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT as the source stage, as the VUID requires
expected_finding: the TRANSFER_DST -> SHADER_READ_ONLY barriers of streamed_texture (srcStage = shader stages) and copy_target (srcStage = BOTTOM_OF_PIPE) do not include VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, so the fragment-shader reads are not ordered after the copies' writes (VUID-vkCmdPipelineBarrier-srcAccessMask-02815)
